description: We would be delighted to welcome you to our apartment featuring 4 bedrooms.This apartment is ideally located in the Marais district, just steps away from the Picasso Museum, Place des Vosges, and Rue de Bretagne.The spaceThis apartment includes:- A beautiful living area with a sofa, TV, coffee table, and dining table- An open-plan kitchen, fully equipped with all the essentials: refrigerator, freezer, stovetop, coffee machine, toaster, kettle, washing machine, oven, dishwasher…- Four stunning bedrooms, each with a Queen-size bed, wardrobe, and TV. Two of them also feature a desk and private en-suite bathroom with a shower, sink, and toilet- An additional bathroom with a shower and sink- A separate toilet with a sink- Plenty of well-organized storage space to keep your belongings tidy- Bed linens and towels are provided- Complimentary toiletries (shampoo and shower gel) from Typology.- TV and high-speed WiFi to keep you connected during your stayGuest accessMetro:Rambuteau (Line 11) – approximately 1-minute walkArts et Métiers (Lines 3 and 11) – approximately 5-minute walkTemple (Line 3) – approximately 10-minute walkBus:Grenier Saint-Lazare – Quartier de l'Horloge – approximately 2-minute walkCentre Georges Pompidou – approximately 2-minute walk.Other things to noteYour arrival is self check-in: the door is equipped with a secure system and a connected entry code.

enrichment.summary: Marais apartment with 4 bedrooms and 4 queen beds, two en-suite shower/WCs, another shower room and a separate WC. Guests praise the central location and hosts; two reviews mention heat or poor ventilation, and the listing does not advertise air conditioning.

photoReview.bestPhotoReason: Bright wide view of the living and dining area, with the apartment's layout and inviting common space clearly visible.
issues: One review describes the apartment as ground floor, but that floor placement is not stated in the listing description used for access facts.
Some guests mention the apartment can feel hot; air conditioning is not advertised.

themes: Several of the 10 reviews praise the central Marais location and nearby transit, restaurants and attractions.
Several reviews praise the responsive hosts and comfortable, well-equipped rooms.
concerns: Two guests mention heat or limited ventilation; one explicitly says there is no air conditioning.
One guest says the home was not child-friendly.

deepReview.note: Full-size views show four separate bedroom beds, a fitted kitchen, a dining table with at least six chairs, and a tiled shower room. The floor-plan image shows the apartment layout but does not establish the route through the building.
